story.iWant: to ensure the infrastructure is 100% stable upon startup
story.soThat: local development seamlessly transitions onto Auth, Product, and Inventory code integrations without container disruptions
story.tasks: - Construct QA checks (or Taskfile dependencies) enforcing Postgres init.sql schema fires accurately. - Validate Redis connection pings internally. - Check Kafka cluster outputs reporting normal KRaft availability natively.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: No unhandled container resets occur during `task up` deployments globally.
Databases `auth_db`, `products_db`, and `inventory_db` successfully exist isolated across Postgres execution.
